partio.title: Partio
partio.subtitle: Play online party games
partio.description: A party game platform designed to let friends play together online or locally. Partio was built from the ground up with extensibility and multilingual support in mind, making it easy to expand with new games and languages.

solyra_coaching.title: Solyra Coaching
solyra_coaching.subtitle: Website for a Holistic & Systemic coach
solyra_coaching.description: Website for a Holistic & Systemic Coach, featuring appointment scheduling, automated deployments with Vercel, automated emails, and more.

husqy.title: Husqy
husqy.subtitle: General purpose Discord bot
husqy.description: A modular Discord bot designed to provide communities and administrators with a wide range of server-management features. Husqy uses a microservice architecture and includes functionality such as logging, greetings, temporary voice channels, reaction roles, and more. Husqy includes a web dashboard, documentation, configurable modules, and built-in monetization to support increased limits. The project is currently paused due to other priorities, but may be continued in the future.

victreebot.title: Victreebot
victreebot.subtitle: Discord bot for Pokémon GO! communities
victreebot.description: A Discord bot for Pokémon GO! communities, providing features such as raid registration and sign-ups, as well as registering known locations in your area. It helps Pokémon GO! communities coordinate and interact in one central place.

l3keboy_github_io.title: l3keboy.github.io
l3keboy_github_io.subtitle: This website
l3keboy_github_io.description: The current version of my personal website, built with Next.js and hosted on Vercel. It features light and dark themes, multilingual support, and easily configurable content.

ios_qr_validator.title: iOS App - QR_Validator
ios_qr_validator.subtitle: Validate the links behind QR codes
ios_qr_validator.description: An iOS application which allows you to scan QR codes to validate the safety of the links behind them. You can also open these links in an in-app browser of Safari. This project is no longer maintained and has been archived.

ios_timeit.title: iOS App - TimeIt
ios_timeit.subtitle: Timer application
ios_timeit.description: An iOS application which allows you to set a timer and sends a notification when the timer is done. Also features a clock view (with seconds) and a stopwatch with lap support. This project is no longer maintained and has been archived.

ios_factzzz.title: iOS App - Factzzz
ios_factzzz.subtitle: Get random facts
ios_factzzz.description: An iOS application that displays a random fact. It allows you to save favorites (local device only, no iCloud) and share facts. This project is no longer maintained and has been archived.

lukehendriks_net-v2.title: lukehendriks.net - V2
lukehendriks_net-v2.subtitle: V2 of this website.
lukehendriks_net-v2.description: The second version of this website, taking a simpler approach than V1 and focusing solely on a landing page. This project is no longer maintained and has been archived.

lukehendriks_net-v1.title: lukehendriks.net - V1
lukehendriks_net-v1.subtitle: V1 of this website.
lukehendriks_net-v1.description: The first version of this website, built with a Laravel backend and Next.js frontend. It included features such as a contact form secured with Google reCAPTCHA v3 and automated email delivery. This project is no longer maintained and has been archived.

Hero.title: Building cloud <styled>infrastructure</styled> and <styled>applications.</styled>
Hero.description: I'm Luke, a DevOps Engineer and Full-stack Developer focused on Microsoft Azure, modern cloud-native technologies, and backend development.

Paragraphs.1: I'm a DevOps Engineer from the Netherlands, specializing in Microsoft Azure, cloud infrastructure, automation, and backend development. I studied HBO-ICT at Fontys University of Applied Sciences, specializing in Infrastructure and Cyber Security.
Paragraphs.2: My experience spans cloud infrastructure, software development, containerization, monitoring, security, and CI/CD. I work with technologies including Azure, .NET, C#, Python, Docker, Kubernetes, and Next.js. I'm currently deepening my expertise in Azure and exploring AI.

Paragraphs.1: I completed internships at Isah Business Software (ERP software), where I worked on improving IT monitoring, and Cubics (managed service provider), where I worked on managing Azure tenants for multiple clients.
Paragraphs.2: I am currently working at CZ (Health insurer), where I work on backend systems using .NET and Azure (ARM, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, etc.).
